name: T3 Live
author: EhsanulHaqueSiam
description: Live T3 Code agent threads in the bar: what is working, what needs your answer or approval, and what just finished, with toasts, on this machine and T3's linked machines.

barWidget.description: A compact island worded like T3 mobile's live notification: T3 Working, T3 3 live, or T3 3·1·1 for a mix, and T3 Done when one finishes. Click for each thread; questions and approvals have a button that opens the thread.

schema.label: Other machines
schema.description: Other machines running T3 Code, as ssh hosts separated by commas (e.g. mac, server). Each needs key-based ssh and sqlite3.

schema.label: Linked machines
schema.description: Also show threads from T3 Code's linked environments that this machine can reach over key-based ssh.

schema.label: Notifications
schema.description: Toast when a thread needs you or finishes, and once more if a question waits 5 minutes.

schema.label: Colors
schema.description: T3 uses T3 Code's own vivid phase colors. Theme takes them from the Omarchy theme's palette. Backgrounds and text follow the theme either way.
